head.text: New agent · shorter, with directories as chips

why.text:
3a is the modal as built: eleven field rows under a three-line Joins block, every note inside its field.

What folds: Where goes into the header; the “local · ACP” subtitle goes. Name moves into the header beside the title; the Joins line shows it as the dashed new member. Joins and Group become one line: the group button opens GroupPicker (New group… asks for name and goal). Harness, Model and Thinking are one Agent row; Gateway, Sandbox and Image one Sandbox row. Local: seven rows to two. OpenShell: eleven to three.

Notes leave the fields: the focused field’s note shows once, in the hint line under the rows, with the counts and status that were notes. Errors stay where they are. Model options show the name only.

Directories: a chip per path (basename; full path in the tooltip and the hint), × removes, ⏎ or Tab adds, Browse… for the system picker. No chip is primary. In a new sandbox every upload lands side by side, so (a guess) the adapter starts in the sandbox’s working directory above them. An existing sandbox takes one path inside it; nothing is uploaded into it.

Not built: more than one upload needs Vec<Upload>, sandbox upload after create, a manifest per directory and Bring Back grouped by directory (ISSUES). Extra directories for a local agent depend on the harness; unchecked.
